prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1212; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Good afternoon. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you were involved in while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened before the collision.

A: I was driving on the main road and needed to move into the right lane to make a turn ahead. I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked clear, and signaled. As I started to move over, I felt a bump on the side of my car.

Q: Where were you when you first noticed the other vehicle?

A: I think it was already partly beside me. I didn't see it in the mirror when I checked, so I'm not sure where it came from.

Q: Did you brake or swerve at any point?

A: I tapped the brakes and tried to steer back into my own lane, but the cars scraped together for a second before separating.

Q: Did you stop your vehicle after the impact?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder right away and turned on my hazards.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes, my right knee hit the lower part of the dashboard when we made contact. It swelled up within an hour and it's been painful to bend or put weight on it.

Q: Have you sought medical care for the knee?

A: I went to urgent care that evening. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic doctor because they wanted a closer look at the joint.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to cooperate fully and I'll send over any records I receive.

Q: Thank you. That concludes this statement.

A: Thank you.
